finding.claim: ALLOWED_FIELDS cites the wrong spec sections for two keys: the pinned validator puts `verified` under section 5.2 (5.3 is trust tiers) and root-index `okf_version` under section 12, not 8 (section 8 says a non-root index carries no front matter).

fixes.change: field() wraps a single mapping as a list of one only for verified, so another non-list at a [] path reads as []; the ALLOWED_FIELDS citations now say 4.1, 5.2, and sections 8 and 12.
